code_learning.processing: saved metadata only; named columns and unique name; identical common x/y scale; full15 types and all102710 points; source lexical circle order/log10counts; exact count segments and named colors; all-cell MASS KDE; no sampling

gaps.detail: Source transform_coordinates is Cartesian centering/scaling, not a polar transform; separate-axis divisors deform the embedding.

plot1cell overwrites input color names with global category order then indexes names; caller must align the input vector. SHARE add_track2 does not realign absent categories; adapter uses explicit named colors.
Source get_segment starts at cell1 and ends before next group, causing tiny unpainted intervals; adapter uses exact cumulative count fractions 0..log10(n).
Global density threshold is not cluster-specific outline or confidence interval.
The paper screenshot and data-paper original figures differ; separate original-layout study and bounded data transfer.
